issues.description: The problem statement and template declare Farm.singFarmSong() as returning void and specify that it should print the song, but the solution implements singFarmSong() to return a String (and builds/returns the song text instead of printing). This return-type/behavior mismatch between specification/template and the solution is structural and may confuse students (which approach to implement and whether to print or return the song).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation consistent with the specification and template. Either: (A) change the solution's singFarmSong() signature to return void and have it print the song (e.g., System.out.print/println the built string), or (B) update the problem statement and template to specify singFarmSong() returns String and describe that it should return the full song text (not print). Prefer option (A) to preserve the current UML/specification which expects a void method that prints.
